set.body: Canonical architecture and acceptance authority for eliminating parallel multidimensional-array hierarchies. Ravel NDArray[A,R] is the sole dense buffer, rank, shape, stride, layout, and kernel authority. image4s Sampled[F,D,A,Role,R] is the sole dense sampled-image value: Ravel storage plus Grid geometry, NonSpatialAxes, and role semantics. ScalaFIM NeuroVol and NeuroVec become aliases, extensions, or narrowly scoped zero-copy compatibility views; SparseNeuroVec becomes selected support or GridDomain plus compact rank-2 Ravel storage. Logical image indexing is grid order (i,j,k[,t]), where z is the third grid-axis slice; world and anatomical axes come only from the affine. No duplicate storage owner, geometry model, raw-offset API, or kernel stack may remain. Deliver the ordered contract and evidence court, fast image4s access and views, ScalaFIM dense migration, sparse redesign, duplicate removal, and cross-platform performance and consumer gates. The linked ScalaFIM epic is an execution mirror; this bead owns architecture and acceptance. Exit only when mig-500 can remove duplicate code without compatibility, layout, allocation, or performance regression.
set.title: EPIC: Unify dense image representation across image4s, Ravel, and ScalaFIM
